## 1. Urban Heat

**Map: Mean LST and Green Spaces Polygons**

```{r}
# Ensure consistent CRS 
greenspace2ha <- st_transform(greenspace2ha, crs(london_lst))

# Plot
lst_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = london_lst) +
  geom_sf(
    data = greenspace2ha,
    aes(colour = "Selected\nUGS"),
    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.3,
    key_glyph = "polygon"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#3F78B5",
      "#5DA5DA",

      "#FDB366",
      "#F67E4B",
      "#D94E41"
    ),
    name = "LST (°C)",
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Selected\nUGS" = "black")
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_colourbar(order = 1),

      override.aes = list(
        fill = NA,
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.7
      )
    )

  theme_minimal() +

    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),

  )

```

**Map: SUHII = LST (LSOA) - LST (London)**

```{r}
# Fix geometry
lsoa_lst <- st_make_valid(lsoa_lst)

# set colours
# blue = cooler than London mean, red = hotter than London mean
diff_cols <- rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu"))


# define SUHII breaks
# data range: -9.98 to 8.53 so use -10 and 10 range
lims <- c(-10, 10)

# colours group into 2°C intervals
breaks_seq <- seq(-10, 10, by = 2)

# map plot
map_plot <- ggplot(lsoa_lst) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = lst_differ),
    color = NA,
    linewidth = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = diff_cols,
    breaks = breaks_seq,
    limits = lims,
    oob = squish,
    name = "SUHII"
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# histogram legend plot - each bar = 0.1°C
# colours group into 2°C intervals
hist_legend <- ggplot(
  st_drop_geometry(lsoa_lst),
  aes(x = lst_differ)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(fill = after_stat(x)),
    binwidth = 0.1,
    boundary = -10,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = breaks_seq,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = diff_cols,
    breaks = breaks_seq,
    limits = lims,
    oob = squish,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = lims,
    breaks = seq(-10, 10, by = 4),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "SUHII (°C)",
    y = "LSOA Count"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
  )


# put histogram next to map
suhii_tm <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(
    map_plot,
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    width = 0.78,
    height = 1
  ) +
  draw_plot(
    hist_legend,
    x = 0.63,
    y = 0.11,
    width = 0.25,
    height = 0.22
  )

suhii_tm
```

## 2. Park Cooling Quantification

### 2.1. Data Preparation

```{r}
# check greenspace column names
greenspace %>% colnames()
```

```{r}
# select needed columns only
greenspace_clean <- greenspace %>% 
  select(id, function_, area_ha, park_lst,
         # all of the 20 buffer rings in ascending order
         all_of(paste0("ring_", seq(30, 900, 30))),
         geometry)
```

```{r}
# check any NA values
greenspace_clean %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.))))
```

### 2.2. Cubic Polynomial Curve and Park Cooling Intensity (PCI)

+-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Name                        | Formula                                                      | Literature Support                                                                      |
+=============================+==============================================================+=========================================================================================+
| Cublic Polynomial Curve     | +---------------------+                                      | Du *et al.*, 2022; Cai *et al.*, 2023; Xiong, Xie and Yang, 2024; Yang *et al.*, 2024   |
|                             | | ```                 |                                      |                                                                                         |
|                             | | T(r)=ar^3+br^2+cr+d |                                      |                                                                                         |
|                             | | ```                 |                                      |                                                                                         |
|                             | +---------------------+                                      |                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| PCI                         | +----------------------------------------------------------+ | Peng *et al.*, 2021; Du *et al.*, 2022; Xiong, Xie and Yang, 2024; Zhang *et al.*, 2024 |
|                             | | ```                                                      | |                                                                                         |
|                             | | PCI=\frac{L{\times}T_L-{{\int}_0^L}T(r)dr}{L{\times}T_L} | |                                                                                         |
|                             | | ```                                                      | |                                                                                         |
|                             | +----------------------------------------------------------+ |                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Park Cooling Gradient (PCG) | +----------------------------------------------+             | Peng *et al.*, 2021; Xiong, Xie and Yang, 2024                                          |
|                             | | ```                                          |             |                                                                                         |
|                             | | PCG=\frac{L{\times}T_L-{{\int}_0^L}T(r)dr}{L |             |                                                                                         |
|                             | | ```                                          |             |                                                                                         |
|                             | +----------------------------------------------+             |                                                                                         |
+-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

```{r}
# Ring distances in metres — x values for polynomial fitting
x_vals <- seq(30, 900, 30)
ring_cols <- paste0("ring_", seq(30, 900, 30))

# create an empty list to store results for later
results <- list()

# for loop for each greenspace
for (i in 1:nrow(greenspace_clean)) {
  # for each greenspace
  park <- greenspace_clean[i, ]
  # mean LST values of buffer ring 
  y_ring_lst <- as.numeric(unlist(park[, ring_cols] %>% st_drop_geometry(), use.names = FALSE))
  # park LST values
  park_lst <- as.numeric(park$park_lst)
  
  # fit a cubic polynomial curve: T(x) = ax3 + bx2 + cx + d
  poly_curve <- lm(y_ring_lst ~ poly(x_vals, degree = 3, raw = TRUE))
  
  # coefficients
  coefs <- coef(poly_curve)
  d <- coefs[1]
  c <- coefs[2]
  b <- coefs[3]
  a <- coefs[4]
  
  # calculate R squared 
  # it is said there is found less error with higher r2 (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41599-023-02209-5)
  r2 <- summary(poly_curve)$r.squared
  
  # turning point of curve --> find where temp stop decreasing/ increasing
  # find derivative: T'(x) = 3ax2 + 2bx + c 
  disc <- (2*b)^2 - 4*(3*a)*c
  # parks with no valid turning point, return as NA
  if (is.na(disc) || disc < 0) {
    Lmax <- NA
    # LST value at the first turning point
    TL <- NA
    accumulated_cooling <- NA
    PCI <- NA
    PCG <- NA
    max_lst_diff <- NA
  } else {
   
    # distances where temp stops increasing/ decreasing
    root1 <- (-(2*b) + sqrt(disc)) / (2 * 3*a)
    root2 <- (-(2*b) - sqrt(disc)) / (2 * 3*a)
    
    # only keep turning points within ring range 30 - 900m
    valid_roots <- c(root1, root2)
    valid_roots <- valid_roots[valid_roots >= 30 & valid_roots <= 900]
    
    if (length(valid_roots) == 0) {
      Lmax <- NA
      TL <- NA
      accumulated_cooling <- NA
      PCI <- NA
      PCG <- NA
      max_lst_diff <- NA
    } else {
      
      # identify whether turning point is at highest point of curve
      # T''(x) = 6ax + 2b
      second_derivative <- 6 * a * valid_roots + 2 * b
      
      # Keep only peaks
      peak_roots <- valid_roots[second_derivative < 0]
      # if it s not a peak, return as NA
      if (length(peak_roots) == 0) {
        Lmax <- NA
        TL <- NA
        accumulated_cooling <- NA
        PCI <- NA
        PCG <- NA
        max_lst_diff <- NA
      } else {
        
        # select the initial turning point (first peak) as cooling distance
        Lmax <- min(peak_roots)
        
        # calculate fitted LST at the Lmax
        TL <- a * Lmax^3 + b * Lmax^2 + c * Lmax + d
        
        # calculate actual_accumulated_lst from 0 to Lmax
        actual_accumulated_lst <- (a/4 * Lmax^4) +
          (b/3 * Lmax^3) + 
          (c/2 * Lmax^2) + 
          (d   * Lmax)
        
        # calculate accumulated PCI
        accumulated_cooling <- (Lmax * TL) - actual_accumulated_lst
        
        # PCI
        PCI <- accumulated_cooling / (Lmax * TL)
        
        # calculate PCG (Park cooling gradient)
        # PCG = accumulated cooling area/ maximum cooling distance (https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2210670723007205)
        PCG <- accumulated_cooling / Lmax
        
        # calculate max temperature difference
        max_lst_diff <- TL - park_lst
      }
    }
  }
  
  # store results
  results[[i]] <- data.frame(
    id = park$id, # park ID
    r2 = round(r2, 3), # R squared, how well the curve fits the data
    Lmax = round(Lmax, 1), # estimated cooling distance
    TL = round(TL, 2), # temp at Lmax
    max_lst_diff = round(max_lst_diff, 2), # difference between surrounding temp and park temp
    accumulated_cooling = round(accumulated_cooling, 1), # accumulated cooling area, old PCI formula
    PCI = round(PCI, 4), # PCI
    PCG = round(PCG, 2) # park cooling gradient
  )
}

# combine results
pci_results <- bind_rows(results)

# check
cat("Total parks:", nrow(pci_results), "\n")
cat("Parks with valid PCI:", sum(!is.na(pci_results$PCI)), "\n")
cat("Parks with no turning point:", sum(is.na(pci_results$PCI)), "\n")

summary(pci_results$accumulated_cooling)
summary(pci_results$PCI)
summary(pci_results$PCG)
summary(pci_results$r2)
```

```{r}
# join PCI results back to greenspace_clean
greenspace_pci <- greenspace_clean %>%
  left_join(pci_results, by = "id")
```

### 2.3. Identify Cooling Effective UGS

```{r}
# identify cooling effective parks
cooling_effective <- greenspace_pci %>%
  filter(
    # filter away all NA
    !is.na(Lmax),
    !is.na(max_lst_diff),
    !is.na(PCI),
    !is.na(PCG),
    # filter temp difference > 0
    max_lst_diff > 0,
    # filter normalised cooling > 0
    PCI > 0,
    # filter PCG > 0
    PCG > 0
  )
```

```{r}
# check number of cooling effective UGS: 
nrow(cooling_effective)
```

```{r}
# check stats
cooling_effective %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(
    # number of cooling effective ugs
    cooling_effective_parks = n(),
    # lst difference
    min_max_lst_diff = min(max_lst_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_max_lst_diff = max(max_lst_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_max_lst_diff = mean(max_lst_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_max_lst_diff = median(max_lst_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    # PCI
    min_PCI = min(PCI, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_PCI = max(PCI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_PCI = mean(PCI, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_PCI = median(PCI, na.rm = TRUE),
    # PCG
    min_PCG = min(PCG, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_PCG = max(PCG, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_PCG = mean(PCG, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_PCG = median(PCG, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Lmax
    mean_Lmax = mean(Lmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_Lmax = median(Lmax, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

**Map: Cooling Effective UGS by PCI**

```{r}
# Match CRS
gla_boundary <- st_transform(gla_boundary, st_crs(greenspace_pci))

# Create 4 equal-interval PCI breaks using cooling-effective parks only
pci_breaks <- seq(
  min(cooling_effective$PCI, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(cooling_effective$PCI, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 5
)

# Clean legend labels
pci_labels <- paste0(
  sprintf("%.2f", pci_breaks[-length(pci_breaks)]),
  " - ",
  sprintf("%.2f", pci_breaks[-1])
)

# Blue palette: low PCI = light blue, high PCI = dark blue
pci_blues <- c(
  "#C6DBEF", 
  "#6BAED6", 
  "#3182BD", 
  "#08519C"
)

# Create map categories
greenspace_map <- greenspace_pci %>%
  mutate(
    cooling_effective_flag =
      !is.na(max_lst_diff) &
      !is.na(PCI) &
      !is.na(PCG) &
      max_lst_diff > 0 &
      PCI > 0 &
      PCG > 0,

    PCI_bin = cut(
      PCI,
      breaks = pci_breaks,
      labels = pci_labels,
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    PCI_map_category = if_else(
      cooling_effective_flag,
      as.character(PCI_bin),
      "Not Cooling-Effective"
    ),

    PCI_map_category = factor(
      PCI_map_category,
      levels = c("Not Cooling-Effective", pci_labels)
    )
  )

# Plot map
pci_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = gla_boundary,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = greenspace_map,
    aes(fill = PCI_map_category),
    colour = NA
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "PCI",
    values = c(
      "Not Cooling-Effective" = "grey80",
      setNames(pci_blues, pci_labels)
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

pci_map
```

)

### 2.5. Limitations

Did not remove pixels of water bodies, vegetation that potentially overlap with the buffer rings.
